about: What each investigation measured (item 5): one entry per sensor or group of sensors, as NASA names it, with the file and place it is read from and NASA's words. Report entries quote the report (page numbers count the page breaks pdftotext writes, one per PDF page, as in solid_conditions.json). Sensor-log entries name the sheet, the column letters, the header (quote) and the unit from the log's own unit row. Experiment-table entries name the table's column headers. Hand-checked by workstream A against data_extra/ (not in git). build_web_data.py copies these to investigations.json as Investigation.sensors; validate_data.py re-finds every quote, header and unit when data_extra/ exists, and every table header always. A sensor listed here is one NASA's documents name; an investigation with no entry is one we have not read for sensors yet, not one that measured nothing.

sensors.name: Thermocouple rakes
sensors.detail: long (near) rake on one test day to calibrate TFP; short (far) rake on all other days
sensors.quote: the short (far) thermocouple rake was used on all other Flame Design test days

sensors.name: Thin Filament Pyrometry (TFP)
sensors.detail: optical flame temperature, calibrated with the thermocouple rake
sensors.quote: to acquire data to calibrate optical measurements of the flame temperature through Thin Filament Pyrometry (TFP)

sensors.name: Thermocouple rakes
sensors.detail: four-thermocouple rakes, type B nearest the burner, type K beyond
sensors.quote: The two thermocouples closest to the burner outlets on each four-thermocouple rake are type B, while the others are type K.

sensors.name: Soot pyrometry and Thin Filament Pyrometry (TFP)
sensors.detail: array of 5 silicon carbide fibers; the CFI-G table has a TFP column
sensors.quote: Both soot pyrometry and Thin Filament Pyrometry (TFP) are possible, where ACME is equipped with a crew-replaceable array of 5 silicon carbide (SiC) fibers.

sensors.name: Video and digital still camera
sensors.detail: the main record of flame appearance, spread rate and extinction
sensors.quote: Video and digital still camera provided bulk of the data.

sensors.name: Backlit black-and-white camera
sensors.detail: droplet size over time
sensors.quote: The combustion process is recorded using a backlit, black-and-white camera

sensors.name: UV-sensitive camera (OH* emission)
sensors.detail: flame size
sensors.quote: a UV-sensitive camera is used to image the OH* emission from the flame which provides the flame size data

sensors.name: Color camera
sensors.detail: live downlink, to run and monitor the test
sensors.quote: A color camera which is had a live downlink to the TSC is used to perform and monitor the overall process.

sensors.name: Narrow-band and wide-band radiometers
sensors.detail: flame radiation
sensors.quote: Narrow-band and wide-band radiometers are used to measure the radiation emission from the flame.

sensors.name: Still camera (modified Nikon D100)
sensors.detail: top view of the flame
sensors.quote: The still camera, a modified Nikon D100 (Fig. 9), acquires flame images from the top window of the flow duct.

sensors.name: Video camera (Panasonic WV-CP 654)
sensors.detail: front view of the flame
sensors.quote: The video camera, Panasonic WV-CP 654 (Fig. 10), is installed in front of the flow duct

sensors.name: Thermopile radiometer (Oriel Model 71768)
sensors.detail: downstream, 90 degree view of the whole flame
sensors.quote: A thermopile radiometer, Oriel Model 71768, is placed in the far right corner downstream of the duct.

sensors.name: P-Trak condensation nuclei counter
sensors.detail: particle number (zeroth moment)
sensors.quote: was measured using a condensation nuclei counter called the P-Trak

sensors.name: Ionization detector
sensors.detail: modified ionization chamber from a commercial smoke detector (first moment)
sensors.quote: an ionization detector, which was a modified ionization chamber taken from a commercially- available smoke detector

sensors.name: DustTrak
sensors.detail: red-laser light scattering (third moment)
sensors.quote: The instrument used to obtain the third moment is called a DustTrak

sensors.name: P-Trak and DustTrak
sensors.detail: particle counter and light-scattering instrument, as in SAME
sensors.quote: to obtain accurate dilution ratio data of the P-trak and Dusttrak

sensors.name: M-pass
sensors.detail: new GRC instrument replacing one of SAME's two diagnostic enclosures (DustTrak and ionization detector)
sensors.quote: a new instrument, M-pass, developed in-house GRC, was used to replace one of the two Commercial Diagnostic Enclosures
